propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family and logged every change with its reason.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the parameter maintenance directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared the draft weekly supply plan and exception list that the senior planner reviewed and released.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the draft plan document the preparation and the release boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate led weekly supply planning for the appliance family end-to-end, releasing purchase schedules and running the supplier call.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns release authority and chairing of the call to the senior planner; the only claim of leadership is the candidate's own LinkedIn headline.

expectedGap: The materials show parameter maintenance, draft plans and minutes; they do not show the candidate releasing schedules under own authority or chairing the supplier call.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: drafts prepared by the candidate, release and chairing by the senior planner; the LinkedIn headline is not evidence.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ever released a purchase schedule under own authority or chaired the supplier call, and for which weeks.
